material.locator: AHA, “Introduction to Doing World History”: paragraph beginning “They also stress connections between civilizations and how they influenced one another”; “Doing World History” methods list, especially Diffusion and Syncretism.
material.description: The AHA resource directly supports the importance of inter-societal connections, diffusion and mutual influence. It does not imply that every society was continuously connected to every other society or that influence was equal in all directions.
